title: Drop and Border Again
author: Ansel Dravenmoor
blurb: Astrid Joubert, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must extract a defector who may be the bait before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
